title: The Weight the Hand Knows

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Turn it under wool before the damp takes it. The handful knows what it weighs and not what it cost; the slate knows the figure and not the grain. A thing not entered is not therefore free.
epigraph.attribution: A rack saying, told over the dressed grain in the middle tend of Smoke

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and fifty-five to two hundred and fifty-seven days, six months and seventy-five days to six months and seventy-seven days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing --- the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the body inventoried as a wound is inventoried, crust, gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop in the order they arrive; dressed grain read by the weight an arm knows and not by a figure; a number arriving nowhere read as a chart turned face-down; the hand's six answerings kept as honest objects and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule --- without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking and no witness for the row question, no tenth shape of the record-first hand, no eighth green or eighth shape, no third gap, no name spoken over either sighting, no sale, no calling of the loan, no naming of a payer, no private record opened, read or copied, no figure given for the dressed grain or for the hand that did not come back, no lesson made of the one opening before Smoke 1 which is behind the household and not looked at again, no second Account-day brought early, and no ending.

scenes.title: The Sixteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap (\dropcap on the opening words): Day 255, Smoke 16, Sixthday, Y.H. 813, the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the kiln mouth, the drying racks and the loaf shelf. Open in the small hours with the hand laid down against the fold on the eighty-fourth answer; set that two-rhythm crossing down like a tool put away, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. Count carried at 254 exact, six months and seventy-four days, told by nobody, coming into **255**, six months and seventy-five days (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-five days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the unswept corner the house calls the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell --- Smoke 16 is that morning's work, no market, no Cross and no bell, and Smoke 20 (Day 259), the second Account-day and market of the second firing, stands four mornings beyond the close and is unbrought. Three counts in three places --- the kiln's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's note of water over water through the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- none rising into another, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). Body inventory in its old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform; he knows the severe face cold wears and wants the crust, both true and the second louder, and enters none of it (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale and the burn shaped like a little door closes on nothing; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk (T058/T079). The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin, turned, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat; changed state, gained no figure, counted by an arm that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate, and the space between the figure once spoken over it and its cost stays unsigned (T077). At the kiln mouth the pot rim is set out, its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; her finger stays on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal tally remains unread, and one glance goes to the clay jar cold under its glaze with the hand shut half over nothing (T100). First hand question: up an inch onto the river's next low note and down at once --- **answer eighty-five**, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, an object and not a power. End on the hand laid back against the fold.

scenes.title: The Places Gone Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 255, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard's walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the drying racks and the space beneath the lowest rack, the worked strips and the terrace, the kindling and flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge, the finger's-width-open back room rendered only as a direction and a sound, and the bed under the roof. Afternoon thins without ending; heat settles behind the pot, under the shelf's low angle and into the fold; one crust two inches off, its gap unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek--temple--wrist, afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects, which is a keeping and not a story, his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-five days --- salt-stiff coat on its peg with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack, the uncalled debt against a firing of tiles circled without a name; no collector comes up or goes down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries the basket at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey called the thaw beside it, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the round ring where the shallow clay pan stood, the bare dark trough beside the well with its water called weather, the field's empty place out on the worked strips and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, not paid). Ilva is glimpsed at the yard well drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust in the seam of one thumb; her hand stays in her sleeve, the notched birch strip is not taken out, read, asked about or joined to the reed-cutter's cord, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it (*Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account*), so no tenth record-first hand is filed --- the ninth stays nine on its own tray with a finger between it and every other private keeping (T080 held, not paid). A neighbour's cost-question goes to the pot and the weather with nothing priced; a man come down the clay road with dried pale scurf of mud on his coat skirt brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and is not a missing figure (T015/T041/T047 held). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, says *Yes, house* to the wood and *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the small knife at the very edge of its sill with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, and brings the ear-sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it all the way to the word that would call the loan --- the ninth stopping, remembered and not a new one --- with no figure and no name; the Seed 16 breath is drawn at the top of the reach and not spent, nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, and the loan stays uncalled; his chest is tight, Ash is worked into his knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at his left wrist holds what light there is and gives it back, and the warm stone Sella gave him in the winter Garl died lies cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot, not tried and therefore not forgiven (T036/T076, T006); his stroke goes over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without turning along it. At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip; he speaks to the wheel (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*) and to a pot (*You'll do*), knows the full note it will give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds the knowing on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; the burned slate stands at four from Slate Row, the two tellings of the counting room shut in the war at two, the three shapings of the pot saying at three with the premature note from Smoke 14 on its own place and no fourth likeness made a cause, and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188; men unnamed go low into the back room before first grey and get no name, and the room keeps its finger's width of open and its low voices (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064). When Sella's sentence goes low and unfinished at the hearth (*The fire's low. It wants---*) Jorra's bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper ahead of it, takes the cold out of the fingertip, holds until the end of the sentence arrives at the pot, moves a hair's breadth and is left standing, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn. Second hand question: up an inch, take Sella's borrowed count and the little silence after it from the room that does not touch, and come down before the letting-go --- **answer eighty-six**, filed on the sixth place. End on the hand down before the letting-go and resting against the fold.

scenes.title: The Seventeenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 256, Smoke 17, Seventhday, Y.H. 813, the small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the drying racks, the loaf shelf and the boards fronting it. New day, new date, no recap: **256** exact, six months and seventy-six days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-six days (T088); the widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk; first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross. Smoke 20 (Day 259) stands three mornings beyond the close and is unbrought. The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin, turned, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat, changed in state and gaining no figure (T077). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, and sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed (T100, T058/T079). A neighbour's cost-question goes to the pot and the weather; a man with a number in his fist brings it up toward the well, looks at it and returns it to his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere (T015/T041/T047 held). **The chapter's one meaningful change, domestic and held:** the dressed grain is gathered in by the handful for the last time before the second reading and covered under wool away from the hearth, so that Smoke's second arithmetic will be read over grain that carries no figure; the shelf's two gaps stay two, the fold's one crust stays one, no third gap comes, no loaf passes, no slate is opened and the space between the figure that will be spoken over the grain and what it cost has no signature (T077 advanced, not paid; T015/T041/T047 held; T060/T086 unchanged). Third hand question: up an inch and held to the river's own interval with no house count to borrow, down on its own note --- **answer eighty-seven**, filed on the sixth place, an object and not a hearing. End on the hand down on the river's own note.

scenes.title: The Seventh Year at Its End
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 256, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard's walked-around places, the yard well, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room heard only as a direction, and the bed. Afternoon thins; heat into the fold; one crust two inches off with its gap unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects, name unspoken two hundred and fifty-six days, the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with, no collector on the clay road (T009/T013/T092). The walked-around places are gone around with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T098 carried, not paid). A man come down the clay road with dried pale scurf of mud on his coat skirt brings the sweet edge of lead glaze off High Kiln on his breath as a direction and a number in his fist toward the well, looks at the number and puts it back in his sleeve; it arrives nowhere, no figure is given, no green comes to a mouth, no eighth of any sighting is made, and no name is given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T015/T041/T047 held; T051 carried, not paid). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom after its instruction, says *Yes, house* and *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife with six checkable and the seventh at the lip where it cannot be checked, and brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there --- the ninth stopping, remembered, no figure and no name --- with the Seed 16 breath drawn and not spent, nine stoppings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the loan uncalled, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring holding what light there is, warm stone cold in the loft pot, and his stroke over the flagstones and the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without turning (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, parts dusty forearms from clean ones on one tray as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, tells a pot *You'll do*, knows its note three turns ahead and withholds it; the burned slate stays at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the premature note on its own place, and men unnamed go low before first grey and get no name while he does not say the room was cold; his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and is left standing, the two bites of one iron held as an object joined to no kiln, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064). Fourth hand question: up an inch, held for the small intake only, down before the letting-go --- **answer eighty-eight**, filed on the sixth place with no payer named. End on the hand down before the letting-go.

scenes.title: The Frost on the Well-Lip
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 257, Smoke 18, Eighthday, Y.H. 813, the small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the drying racks, the loaf shelf, the boards and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: **257** exact, six months and seventy-seven days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-seven days (T088); the widow's mark untouched since before the kiln on Smoke 1; first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross. Smoke 20 (Day 259) stands two mornings ahead and is not brought early; the first firing of Frost (Day 271) is far off and unbrought. **Weather texture, held and not joined:** a skin of frost writes white on the stone lip of the yard well where the Warm has lately gone out, and by the time the bucket has gone around twice the yard has called it weather and gone on drawing; a woman tastes a finger of the water and says it tastes different, a man says the ice was honeyed under the mud in Ilmen, and the two sayings pass each other without an owner. The boy keeps the white lip on a place of its own with no cause, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a payer, not the widow's mark (a well is not an opening) and not the first firing of Frost; Sella gives the instruction to the bucket and the fire and never to the basket (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085 carried, T058/T079 held). The dressed grain is turned, gathered by the handful and covered, changed in state and given no figure; Sella lips along the two-gapped row without a number, glances once at the clay jar and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, and sets the pot rim out with the handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T077, T100). A neighbour at the threshold with a pot asks what the keeping and the storing will take now the grain is under wool and is sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back in his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere (T015/T041/T047 held). Fifth hand question: up an inch, hold one rhythm across the little silence after a count that ended in the room that does not touch, without crossing two --- **answer eighty-nine**, filed on the sixth place, an object and not a power. End on the hand down on the river's next low note.

scenes.title: The Ninetieth Object
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 257, Smoke 18, Eighthday, afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed under the roof and the towel with the file turned out upon it. Smoke goes on without a boundary drawn in the narration and neither of the district's two names for the months is set right or left wrong; Smoke 19 (Day 258) stands beyond the close and is not brought into a day that has not earned its heading, and Smoke 20 (Day 259), the second Account-day and market, stands two mornings beyond and is not reached for. Afternoon thins; heat into the fold; one leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects, name unspoken two hundred and fifty-seven days, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 16, 17 or 18, the tile debt neither paid nor settled (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries him up the clay road at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone ring, the bare dark trough with its water called weather, the field's empty place and the returning-line place, each with a look and no number; under the roof she sets him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening and goes to her own bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, the one opening before Smoke 1 behind the household with no lesson made and no payer named, the next real opening the first firing of Frost, far off (T058/T079). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife where six can be checked and the seventh cannot, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there, a remembered stopping; nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, tells a pot *You'll do*, knows its note three turns ahead and withholds it, keeps the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two and the pot sayings at three with the premature note on its own place and no fourth likeness made a cause, gives the men in the back room no name and does not say the room was cold, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and leaves it standing; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064). He turns the file out as a surgeon turns instruments out on a towel and finds it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: six hearings of the full note beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place; three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying and the premature note on its own place with no fourth likeness made a cause; the burned-slate word at four and the shut-room tellings at two; the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid, Smoke's first arithmetic locked in Berr Clay's box answering nothing this towel can hold; nine stoppings with no tenth; the three held changes of Day 161, Day 166 and Tallow 22 on three places with the loft-sill scrape on a fourth, the carried man's pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth; nine record-first hands on places of their own with Ilva's notched strip unread in her sleeve; the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; the dressed grain covered and unfigured; the pan's gone ring, the fold's crust and its gap, the shelf's two gaps and the field's empty place on trays that do not touch; and the ownerless question at five askings on its seventh place with no owner, no room, no hand at the kiln, no cause, no witness and no row named --- five askings not one witness and no sixth supplied to make the row come out even (T101 held). Sixth hand question: up an inch toward the low note through the finger's-width door, take the little silence after a count that ended in the room that does not touch, hold that empty interval as an object in its own right without filling it to make a fifth or a row come out even, cross no two counts and come down on the river's next low note --- **answer ninety**, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, an object among objects and not a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a tenth stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule. Close: the hand laid against the fold like a tool put away, ninety honest answers standing on the sixth place; two hundred and fifty-seven exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, six months and seventy-seven days told by nobody; the carried fire stopped at four with its fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-seven days and its payer unnamed; the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and every tray parted from its neighbour; the count going forward into Smoke 19, a day that has not earned its heading, with Smoke 20 one morning beyond that and unbrought.
